findings.current: “L-Team Leader. May I come in for a moment?”
findings.defect: The initial stutter is on the T sound of “Team Leader,” not an L sound.
findings.rationale: The source stutters 팀장님 as 티, 팀장님.
findings.replacement: “T-Team Leader. May I come in for a moment?”

findings.current: Go Jun, who had been turning away roughly, came to an abrupt stop.
findings.defect: The draft says Go Jun was already turning, while 돌아서려던 means he was about to turn away.
findings.rationale: The prospective construction preserves that his intended movement was arrested before he completed it.
findings.replacement: Go Jun, who had been about to turn away, came to an abrupt stop.
findings.source: 거칠게 돌아서려던 석고준의 신형이 우뚝 멈췄다.

findings.current: “Yes. We’re monitoring the members dispatched to the site at regular intervals because we’re concerned they might sneak something away. There’s no doubt.”
findings.defect: “At regular intervals” turns frequent, ongoing surveillance into periodic checks, weakening the stated basis for certainty.
findings.rationale: 수시로 감시 중 indicates that they are being watched continually or whenever necessary, specifically to prevent them from stealing the sought belongings.
findings.replacement: “Yes. We’re keeping the team members dispatched to the site under constant watch in case they try to pocket something. There’s no doubt.”
findings.source: “예. 현장에 파견된 팀원들이 빼돌릴 것을 염려해 수시로 감시 중이니 확실합니다.”

findings.current: Not merely because it was the keepsake of the man he had followed like a father.
findings.defect: The draft omits that the deceased man was Go Jun’s Master, losing explicit hierarchy and relationship information.
findings.rationale: 스승 explicitly identifies Lee Jungryong as Go Jun’s Master, while 아버지처럼 describes how Go Jun regarded and followed him.
findings.replacement: Not merely because it was a keepsake of the Master he had followed like a father.
findings.source: 아버지처럼 따르던 스승의 유품이기 때문만은 아니다.

findings.current: Every bone in his body had been crushed like matchsticks, and his living flesh had been torn apart as though squeezed by an enormous hand.
findings.defect: The draft invents an enormous hand and changes flesh being torn away as if wrung out into flesh merely being torn apart.
findings.rationale: 쥐어짜듯이 describes the manner of the tearing as wringing or squeezing; it does not introduce a hand, enormous or otherwise.
findings.replacement: Every bone in his body had been crushed like matchsticks, and his living flesh had been torn away as though it were being wrung out.
findings.source: 전신의 뼈가 성냥개비처럼 으스러지고 생살이 쥐어짜듯이 뜯겨나갔다.

findings.current: Jeok Cheongang raised both eyebrows and hooked his fingers like claws as he continued.
findings.defect: The draft replaces Jeok Cheongang’s eyes blazing with anger with the different physical action of raising his eyebrows.
findings.rationale: 두 눈에 쌍심지를 켜다 is an idiom describing an intensely furious glare; the hooked fingers are a separate accompanying action.
findings.replacement: Eyes blazing with fury, Jeok Cheongang raised his fingers like claws and continued.
findings.source: 두 눈에 쌍심지를 켠 적천강이 손가락을 갈고리처럼 치켜세우며 말을 이었다.

summary: Several localized fidelity errors alter an action, omit hierarchy, weaken the surveillance mechanism, add an injury detail, and misrender an angry expression.
